headline: Earnings rebound past weak year, but margins keep slipping
summary_short: Revenue was $6,929.8M (+5.8% q/q, -0.6% y/y) and diluted EPS rose to $5.39 from $2.26 a year ago, though last year's quarter was depressed by a $122.8M after-tax goodwill and franchise-rights impairment; total gross profit fell 3.5% y/y to $1,231.1M.
summary_long: Total gross profit fell 3.5% y/y as new vehicle gross profit dropped 18% on lower unit volume (last year benefited from tariff-driven demand pull-forward and stronger EV volume ahead of the EV tax credit's phase-out) and used vehicle gross profit fell 8% on tight lower-priced inventory, partly offset by 1% growth in parts and service. Operating income rose 46.6% y/y to $319.0M as SG&A held roughly flat while the year-ago quarter absorbed $137.0M of pretax goodwill and franchise-rights impairments. Net income was $182.1M versus $86.4M a year ago. Cash fell to $53.3M from $65.5M last quarter; AutoNation repurchased $157.0M of stock. No forward guidance was issued.

drivers.explanation: Net income and EPS surged year/year mainly because the year-ago quarter absorbed a $122.8 million after-tax goodwill and franchise-rights impairment that did not recur; underlying vehicle gross profit kept softening.
New vehicle unit volume fell as the year-ago quarter benefited from tariff-driven demand pull-forward, plus lower EV unit volume as EV tax credits phased out at the end of Q3 2025.
New vehicle gross profit fell 18% on lower volume and higher average vehicle costs; used vehicle gross profit fell 8% on used-vehicle supply constraints; partly offset by parts and service growth.
The year-ago quarter included $65.3 million of goodwill impairment and $71.7 million of franchise-rights impairment that did not recur this quarter, while SG&A expenses were roughly flat.
Mirrors the operating-income driver: the prior-year quarter's $122.8 million after-tax goodwill and franchise-rights impairment did not recur.

Not isolated by quarter in the release, which discloses only six-month cash flows; year-to-date investing activity included a $316.5 million acquisition and financing included $457.0 million of buybacks.
